description: How an SDK turns a non-2xx HTTP response into its error type. Input: status, headers and raw body. Output: the normalized fields every SDK exposes (status, code, message, details, request_id, retry_after). Covers the five legacy error shapes of docs/api/overview.md and the standard envelope of issue #45.
rules: code: body.error.code if body.error is an object with a string code; else body.error if body.error and body.detail are both strings (e.g. conversation_closed); else status_codes[status]; else "http_<status>".

message: body.error.message; else body.detail when code came from body.error; else body.error when it is a string; else body.errors.detail when it is a string; else "validation failed" when body.errors is an object; else the raw body (trimmed, at most 200 characters) when it is not JSON; else the empty string.
details: body.error.details if present; else body.errors when it is an object without a string detail (changeset errors); else null.
request_id: body.error.request_id if present; else the x-request-id response header; else null.
retry_after: the Retry-After header as integer seconds when it is an integer; else null.

cases.name: envelope
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"validation_failed","message":"text is too long","details":{"text":["should be at most 65536 byte(s)"]},"request_id":"F-body"}}

expected.message: Unauthorized: Invalid or inactive API Key

cases.name: rate_limited_with_retry_after
cases.body: {"error":"Too many requests. Please try again later."}

expected.message: Too many requests. Please try again later.

cases.name: unavailable
cases.body: {"error":"Activity could not be accepted, please retry"}

expected.message: Activity could not be accepted, please retry
